display: Pricing: Nov 2026 — Anthropic / OpenAI / DeepSeek public rates
provenance: Transcribed from the ratified Zorwerk demand dossier §4.1 (2026-11-03) and the vendors' published pricing pages. Rates change; this file is data, not code, so override it with --rates <file> and keep your own date.

anthropic.note: Explicit cache_control breakpoints. A miss bills the whole request at the write rate (1.25x input, 5-minute TTL); a hit bills the cached prefix at 0.1x and the tail at input rate.

openai.note: Automatic prefix caching over the longest previously-computed prefix (>= 1024 tokens, 128-token increments). No write fee; a hit bills the cached prefix at the cached-input rate.

deepseek.note: On-disk context cache, on by default, exact prefix match. A hit bills the cached prefix at the cache-hit rate; no write fee.
